title: Surface temperature (NASA GISTEMP v4)
mission: NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis v4 (GHCNv4 stations + ERSSTv5 oceans)
citation: GISTEMP Team, 2026: GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP), version 4. NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies. https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/ ; Lenssen, N. et al., 2024: A NASA GISTEMPv4 observational uncertainty ensemble. J. Geophys. Res. Atmos., 129, e2023JD040179.
explain: How much warmer or cooler each place is than its own normal, from weather stations and ships.
explain_hi: हर जगह अपने सामान्य से कितनी गर्म या ठंडी है - मौसम केंद्रों और जहाज़ों के माप से।
